scope.frame: the rigid-direction census of FR-FIB, as B1819
scope.object: the curvature along Re tau and the per-line refinement list (cell indices), as aggregates
scope.hypotheses: data-free; aggregates and indices only, through a committed script reusing B1819's manifest check; threshold 0.08 decades

claim_one_line: THE RIGID CENSUS'S CURVATURE ALONG Re TAU AND ITS REFINEMENT LIST (Step B's revision, P-521; aggregates and indices only; data-free): along Re tau the grid is the coarse one -- 7.75% of curvatures exceed 0.08 decades (Im tau: 0.54%, B1819) -- and since a configuration computes every output at once, 98.7% of the Re intervals and 67.7% of the Im intervals hold some series that needs refining; the refinement is near-uniform (Re step 0.05, Im step 0.05: about 154 000 configurations, 86 CPU-hours at the current band), computed once after the reach decision. Sharpens B1819. None of the 19.
